name: pit-config-subdir-root
notes: Operational pitfall: the run is invoked with --root sub, so the effective vitest config is sub/vitest.config.mjs rather than a config at the git worktree root. surface.config_sources must key this file by its worktree-relative path (sub/vitest.config.mjs, §3) so an inert change to it (a trailing comment, not touching instrument-affecting settings like includeTaskLocation/truncateThreshold) still surfaces as config-source-changed between baseline and current. Known constraint (out of scope for this issue): with --root sub, relativeModuleId is computed relative to sub rather than the worktree root, so test_sources comparison may not line up with a worktree-relative baseline; this is consistent across both runs (undefined===undefined) and does not affect the config-source-changed assertions below.

steps.message: inert comment change to subdirectory config
